component.name: Timbre
component.summary: A warm, fast Jellyfin music player

description.p: Timbre is a focused desktop music player for your Jellyfin library. Browse albums, artists, playlists and favourites, then listen without feeds, recommendations or distractions.
Connect to your own Jellyfin server with your own account. Your library and credentials stay on your server and on your device.

ul.li: Albums, artists, songs, playlists and favourites
Queue, shuffle, repeat, seek and volume controls
Desktop media keys and MPRIS integration
Resume playback where you left off
